title: Russell US Style indexes — conditional capping check effective at the open of the last business day of June 2027 (24% / 4.8%-above-48% test struck on the 2027-06-25 close, the Russell reconstitution session)
source: EST: owner-published, read direct by this proposer rather than inherited -- FTSE Russell, 'Capping Methodology Guide', v5.4, September 2026 (lseg.com dam policy-documents, capping-methodology-guide.pdf, HTTP 200, 652,008 bytes; 126 content streams located, 62 inflated and text-extracted in-session 2026-09-08). The guide states the standing rule as a table rather than one year's dates: trigger 'No company is greater than 24%, and all companies that have a weight greater than 4.8% in aggregate are no more than 48% of the index', scheme 'Rule 4.2/RIC 22.5/45', price date 'T-3'. THE 2027 DATE IS RULE-DERIVED, NOT PUBLISHED: FTSE Russell's dated schedule table (the July 2026 Russell US Equity Indexes FAQ that the sibling 2026-09-30 lane read) carries 2026 rows only, so this instance comes from the standing rule -- the last business day of June 2027 is Wednesday 2027-06-30, and T-3 business days back is Friday 2027-06-25. The same T-3 arithmetic reproduced all four of the owner's published 2026 cut-off dates to the day in that sibling's session, including the holiday-aware December one. THE FOOTNOTE THAT COULD CANCEL IT DOES NOT FIRE IN 2027, and it was checked rather than assumed: footnote 3 reads verbatim 'If Russell Reconstitution is scheduled to take effect after the close of the last business day in June, meaning it is effective for the open of the first business day in July, then the quarter-end capping check will not be performed. In such cases, the standard application of capping at the quarterly reviews will be applied, and the capping adjustments already announced will be made effective concurrently with the Russell Reconstitution.' Russell reconstitution 2027 is effective after the close of Friday 2027-06-25 (russell-reconstitution-2027-06-25 in this calendar), and 2027-06-30 is a Wednesday, so recon does not fall on the last business day of June and the exemption is inapplicable. Filed estimate because a proposal is always estimate by contract, because this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, because the confirmed-tier prefixes have no member for an index owner's own published methodology, and because the owner's dated table caveats 'Dates may be subject to change.' Discovered during the fhfa-hpi-2027-06-29 initial research, checked 2026-09-08
notes: DISCOVERED during the fhfa-hpi-2027-06-29 initial research (2026-09-08), whose print lands at T-1 -- the morning before this effective date and the session after the T-3 price date. It is proposed because this calendar carries the class (russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2026-09-30 canonical, ...-2026-12-31 as a proposal) and carries the 2027-06-30 corridor around it (sp-select-sector-secondary-reweight-2027-06-30, fomc-minutes-2027-06-30, russell-reconstitution-2027-06-25) but not this instance. ONE FINDING FOR WHOEVER TAKES THIS ID, AND IT IS A DISAGREEMENT BETWEEN TWO OWNER DOCUMENTS RATHER THAN A DATE PROBLEM. The 2026-09-30 ledger quotes the Capping Methodology Guide as giving the RUSSELL US STYLE family a reference date of 'T-3' and an effective date of 'Last business day in Mar, Jun, Sep and Dec'. Re-extracted here, the guide's own table puts that quarterly row on the FTSE Emerging ex China RIC 22.5/45 rows; EVERY Russell US Style row in the same table -- Russell 1000 Value/Growth, Top 200 Value/Growth, Midcap Value/Growth, Russell 3000E Value/Growth, Top 500 Value/Growth, 2500 Value/Growth -- reads 'Monthly ... T-3 ... Last business day of each month', carrying footnote 3. The dated FAQ the sibling also read (July 2026) does label its schedule row 'Russell US Style Quarter-end Capping'; the guide is the newer document (v5.4, September 2026). So the two owner documents disagree on FREQUENCY -- twelve checks a year or four -- and this proposer takes no position on which governs, having read only the guide today. NEITHER READING MOVES THIS DATE: under the quarterly reading 2027-06-30 is the June quarter-end check, under the monthly reading it is June's monthly check, and both use T-3 = 2027-06-25 and the same trigger. The id keeps the existing class name so the lane that settles the frequency can rename or split it deliberately rather than inherit a second taxonomy from this proposal. Impact low and symbols deliberately EMPTY, following the sibling's measured reasoning rather than re-deriving it: it measured the breach probability at roughly 4% once the earlier quarterly capping review has reset the cohort, no house playbook is index-flow-keyed (0 hits, re-grepped 2026-09-08), and an ETF proxy in symbols would make the deterministic screen trip on mega-cap beta. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
